unit: Algebra · Chapter 4. Trigonometric functions and equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: sin x = a (|a| ≤ 1) ⇒ x = (−1)^k arcsin a + πk; cos x = a (|a| ≤ 1) ⇒ x = ±arccos a + 2πk, k ∈ ℤ; for |a| > 1 there are no solutions.
stages.headlineEnglish: sin x = a (|a| ≤ 1) ⇒ x = (−1)^k arcsin a + πk; cos x = a (|a| ≤ 1) ⇒ x = ±arccos a + 2πk, k ∈ ℤ; for |a| > 1 there are no solutions.

stages.headline: tg x = a ⇒ x = arctg a + πk and ctg x = a ⇒ x = arcctg a + πk (any a).
stages.headlineEnglish: tg x = a ⇒ x = arctg a + πk and ctg x = a ⇒ x = arcctg a + πk (any a).

stages.headline: Special cases: sin x = 0 ⇒ x = πk, sin x = 1 ⇒ x = π/2 + 2πk, cos x = 0 ⇒ x = π/2 + πk, cos x = 1 ⇒ x = 2πk.
